title: SinapsisAI: Scientific Intelligence Hub, RAG Orchestrator, and Hybrid Bibliometric Analytics
description: SinapsisAI is a scientific intelligence, knowledge mapping, and RAG orchestration platform powered by a hybrid architecture (ClickHouse + Neo4j + Qdrant) designed for scholar identification, institutional evaluation, and scientific collaboration network analysis.
